articles.title: Suspected militants open fire and kill 2 police officers guarding polio workers in Pakistan
articles.description: Suspected militants have shot and killed two police officers protecting polio workers during a vaccination campaign in northwestern Pakistan. The attack occurred on Tuesday in Mohmand, a district in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. A third officer was wounded. The officers were traveling to guard vaccination teams when they came under fire. The attackers fled, and no group has claimed responsibility. The Pakistani Taliban and other groups often target anti-polio drives, falsely claiming they are Western conspiracies. Pakistan launched a nationwide campaign on Monday to vaccinate 24 million children against polio. Pakistan and Afghanistan remain the only countries where wild poliovirus is endemic.
